title: La chaux-de-fonds (Switzerland) waste water treatment plant microbial community monitoring
description: The study monitored wastewater treatment plant microbial evolution of the city of La Chaux-de-Fonds, Switzerland. Samples were collected at different stages of the treatment plant during two monitoring period between 2018 and 2020. The first phase focused on inlet, outlet, and overflow channels, while the second phase monitored inlet, biological treatment stages, and outlet.
